_doc:
Per-page header content for the movie-title board (components/movie-header/header.php). A section in page_sections.json with "header": "<key>" gets this block merged in as component args.

TEXT (all optional except title): kicker = line above the board; subtitle = small curved line inside, above the headline; title = the carved headline (required - the board renders nothing without it); arc_text = text set along the lower curve; ribbon = plaque slung under the board; ornament = side motif, one of crossed | rope | chain | botanical.

LOOK: an optional "style" object overrides the board's own CSS variables for THAT page only, so a page can carry its own timber and gold without touching CSS. Colours accept #hex, rgb() or rgba() and are rejected otherwise. Keys: wood_darkest, wood_dark, wood_mid, wood_warm, wood_light, gold_1..gold_4, gold_deep, stone, stone_light, stone_shade, stone_deep, ink, sheen, sunlight, shadow. Numbers (clamped): grain, relief, cracks, gloss, shade (0-1 opacities), roughness (0-30, how hand-cut the board edge is - 0 is machine-straight), frame_w and board_h (px), title_lift (px, nudges the headline). Anything omitted falls back to the defaults at the top of header.css.

tag / icon / image are kept for the older flat header part, still used by news and blog posts.
